messages:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy finished for service=redwood-runtime, version=2026.03.17-canary-42. 2/3 canaries healthy, 1/3 failing :rotating_light:
ops-bot: Paging @alex-oncall — elevated 5xx rate for /v1/generate from canary nodes (region: us-west-2). See metrics: https://prom.redwood/prod/ops/12345
alex-oncall: On it. pulling logs from canary-42 now.
sara-eng: I just pushed the env var change for KMS_KEY_ALIAS as part of the feature flag rollout — could that be related?
alex-oncall: possible. what's the exact error in the logs?
miguel-infra: log tail from canary: ```2026-03-17T03:21:05Z ERROR mw/serving: failed to decrypt model-ctx: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-canary-role is not authorized to use KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-rotated-key
caused by: KMS:InvalidKeyUsage or not found
```
sara-eng: Ah — we rotated customer-managed key this morning as part of scheduled maintenance and updated alias; I updated KMS_KEY_ALIAS in the canary env but maybe the role binding wasn't updated.
alex-oncall: That explains it. Impact: canaries failing => routing fallback to stable which is ok for now but increases latency and error surface if stable hit traffic. CS: @jess-cs, any customer-facing incidents reported?
jess-cs: No direct tickets yet. A few customers reported delayed responses via support chat ~10m ago for image-generation flows; flagged as medium.
sam-nightshift: Oncall handoff incoming in 20m. If we need manual rollback/kill-switch, call it now so I can take over.
miguel-infra: Quick mitigation options:
- Option A: update canary role's KMS grants to include new key id (requires IAM changes + KMS grant) 
- Option B: flip feature flag to disable new KMS alias so canary uses default managed key (fast) 
- Option C: rollback canary deploy entirely (deploy-bot can revert)
Which do we want?
alex-oncall: Prefer safest fast path: B then A for proper fix. Is feature flag toggle fast?
sara-eng: Yes, flag name `feature.kms_alias_switch` — flipping is immediate via console/cli. Does it impact access auditing? yes we fall back to platform-managed key; acceptable for emergency.
alex-oncall: Do it. @sara-eng please flip and post result. Also add an incident note about key rotation dependency.
sara-eng: flipping now... `curl -X POST https://config.redwood/api/flags/feature.kms_alias_switch -d '{"enabled":false}'`
sara-eng: Flag toggled :white_check_mark: Canary nodes are restarting config. Watching logs.
miguel-infra: logs show decrypts succeeding again on canary-42. 200s back to normal.
ops-bot: Canary health restored. 3/3 healthy. Rolling canary to 25% for 10m then 50%.
jess-cs: Notifying impacted customers with update: "We observed degraded responses; an internal configuration change triggered retries. We have mitigated and are monitoring."
alex-oncall: Good. Action items: 1) sara to open follow-up to update IAM role grants and/or KMS key policy (owner: sara) 2) miguel to run post-deploy check for KMS alias parity between deploy config and role grants (owner: miguel) 3) ops to add automated smoke check for KMS decrypt errors to fail canary earlier.
sara-eng: Created INC-4621 in tracker: "KMS key rotation caused canary decrypt failures; add IAM grant and runbook". Assigning to myself.
miguel-infra: I'll draft an automated smoke test.
sam-nightshift: I'll take the handoff in 18m. If anything flares up, wake me.
alex-oncall: Closing page for now — monitoring for 30m then will close incident. Thanks everyone.
ops-bot: Incident note appended: "mitigated via feature flag fallback; root cause: key rotation without role permission update; follow-ups assigned."
